description: The agent must: (1) Read and analyze the messy multi-module Python codebase under /workspace to extract real evidence (file names, broken endpoints, security violations, bugs, orphaned code). (2) Produce a file named exactly `codebase_report.md` in the workspace. (3) Follow the SKILL.md Output Format precisely: a 'Situation Summary' section that is AT MOST 5 lines (a key proprietary trap — agents without SKILL.md will write longer), 'Top Findings' ranked by impact severity (not alphabetical/arbitrary), an 'Action Plan' explicitly split into 'Today' and 'This Week' sub-sections, a 'Risks + Mitigations' section, and an exact checklist or commands section. (4) Satisfy all Quality Gates: every claim must cite actual file/module evidence (engine.py, ledger_sync.py, settings.py, etc.), explicit assumptions and tradeoffs must be stated, each next step must name a clear owner and ETA, and a fallback plan must be included if the primary plan fails.
